archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Nex Playground raises over $150 million and plans Japan expansion in 2027

entries.headline: Co-op egg-breaking game CRACK announced for PC, launches October 27
entries.summary: Rafoli announced CRACK, a one-to-four-player incremental adventure about breaking open a giant egg and exploring a mysterious laboratory. The Steam release is planned for October 27.
entries.verification: Two independent opened media sources agree on the game, platform, player count and date.
entries.timeNote: Both source timestamps fall inside the fixed Daily window.

entries.headline: Nex Playground raises over $150 million, plans Japan and South Korea launch in 2027
entries.summary: Nex said it secured more than $150 million in equity financing and credit facilities. Nex Playground has passed one million units sold, with launches in Japan and South Korea planned for 2027.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON relayed Nex's funding, sales and expansion announcement.
entries.timeNote: The source timestamp falls inside the fixed Daily window.

entries.headline: Lollipop Chainsaw live-action film announced as a prequel
entries.summary: Dragami Games confirmed a live-action Lollipop Chainsaw film is in development as an R-rated action comedy and prequel centered on Juliet; no cast or release date has been announced.
entries.verification: IGN directly reported Dragami Games' confirmation and project description.
entries.timeNote: The source timestamp falls inside the fixed Daily window.

entries.headline: Tokyo Game Show 2026 cancels its fifth day due to typhoon
entries.summary: CESA cancelled all Tokyo Game Show 2026 activities planned for September 21 because of expected strong winds, heavy rain and transport disruption from an approaching typhoon. The show had planned a five-day schedule to mark its 30th anniversary.
entries.verification: Gematsu relayed CESA's full cancellation notice.
entries.timeNote: The source timestamp falls inside the fixed Daily window.

entries.headline: Wuthering Waves Version 3.7 launches September 30
entries.summary: Kuro Games set Wuthering Waves Version 3.7 for September 30, adding new quests, an area, Resonators Hsin and Suoming, Echoes and events.
entries.verification: Gematsu relayed Kuro Games' Version 3.7 announcement.
entries.timeNote: The source timestamp falls inside the fixed Daily window.

entries.headline: CONTROL Resonant review embargo lifts with an 84 Metacritic average
entries.summary: A 3DM review-score roundup reported CONTROL Resonant at an 84 Metacritic average from 56 reviews at publication time, with IGN and Push Square each awarding 8/10. The first game had an overall score of 82.
entries.verification: The opened 3DM page is treated as a media report rather than official score data.
entries.timeNote: The page timestamp falls inside the fixed Daily window.

entries.headline: Factory-automation defense game BELTFED announced for PC
entries.summary: Hello World Studios announced BELTFED. Players build conveyor belts, smelting and production facilities, turning an automated factory into defensive lines against insect hordes numbering in the hundreds of thousands. A PC (Steam) release is planned for 2027.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON relayed the developer's announcement, gameplay premise, platform and release year.
entries.timeNote: The source timestamp falls inside the fixed Daily window.

entries.headline: Shangri-La Frontier: Nanatsu no Saikyoshu details its RPG design at TGS 2026
entries.summary: Netmarble's TGS presentation detailed an RPG that recreates the source world's setting, adds original side stories and positions the Seven Strongest Species as endgame content. It is in development for PC, iOS and Android.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON's opened report records the TGS presentation and platform details.
entries.timeNote: The source timestamp falls inside the fixed Daily window.

entries.headline: Two NieR game-and-soundtrack bundles launch on Steam
entries.summary: Square Enix released two special Steam bundles pairing NieR games with original soundtracks on September 19, alongside a launch sale.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report records the September 19 Steam bundle launch.
entries.timeNote: The packet confirms the item belongs to the fixed window; no exact publication time is inferred.

entries.headline: Mobile Suit Gundam Extreme Vs. 2 Infinite Boost announces balance changes for nine units
entries.summary: A TGS 2026 stage presentation detailed balance changes for nine existing units, including Strike Gundam and Hyaku Shiki.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report records the TGS balance-adjustment announcement.
entries.timeNote: The packet confirms the item belongs to the fixed window; no exact publication time is inferred.

entries.headline: Dynasty Warriors 3: Xtreme Legends Complete Edition Remastered to add online two-player play
entries.summary: Koei Tecmo said a post-launch update will add online two-player functionality to the remaster.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report records Koei Tecmo's TGS announcement.
entries.timeNote: The packet confirms the item belongs to the fixed window; no exact publication time is inferred.

entries.headline: Batman × Kamen Rider Zero-One collaboration project announced
entries.summary: DC announced a Batman × Kamen Rider Zero-One collaboration project featuring an original comic and Bandai merchandise, with more details to follow.
entries.verification: The opened Denfaminico Gamer report relays DC's official September 19 announcement of the collaboration, original comic and Bandai merchandise plans.
entries.timeNote: The source timestamp falls inside the fixed Daily window.

entries.headline: Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance confirms Khezu's return
entries.summary: Capcom's TGS 2026 stage demo confirmed Khezu will return in Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance; the expansion is planned for 2027 and also adds Master Rank, new areas and monsters.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report records Capcom's TGS stage demonstration and Khezu's appearance, alongside the announced expansion features and planned 2027 release.
entries.timeNote: The source timestamp falls inside the fixed Daily window.

entries.headline: World of Warcraft: Forever beta draws crowds; developer calls the numbers the wildest of his 17 years at Blizzard
entries.summary: IGN reports queues, disconnections and high latency after the World of Warcraft: Forever beta opened. WoW Classic developer Josh Greenfield called it the 'craziest' turnout he had seen in 17 years at Blizzard. The game is planned to launch on November 4.
entries.verification: The opened IGN report attributes the claims about beta turnout and server conditions to the developer and media reporting.
entries.timeNote: IGN's publication time was converted to Beijing time and falls within this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: Insomniac says Marvel’s Wolverine uses no generative AI; unusual signs caused by a UV mapping bug
entries.summary: Responding to suspicions that unusual restroom signs were made with generative AI, Insomniac community and marketing director James Stevenson attributed them to a UV mapping bug and said a fix was underway. He explicitly stated that Marvel’s Wolverine does not use AI-generated assets.
entries.verification: The opened IGN report directly quotes Insomniac community and marketing director James Stevenson's public response.
entries.timeNote: IGN's publication time was converted to Beijing time and falls within this edition's fixed window.
